# Ground truth for the accuracy benchmark (tests/bench.py).
#   file | kind | text on the line            a real problem that should be reported there
#   file | ~kind | text on the line           a look-alike that must not be
# The text must occur on exactly one line of the file. Any finding not listed as expected counts as a false positive,
# whether or not it's listed as a look-alike; look-alikes are listed so the corpus says what it's testing.
# Labels say what's true, not what codefactory does today: misses stay listed and lower recall.
